name: Apply Wall Primer (Roll Method)
intent: Cut in to ceiling line freehand with brush, then roll primer onto bare drywall walls with an 18-inch roller. Single coat of primer regardless of QT — primer never gets a second coat in NC residential. Texture variants (orange peel, knockdown) require slower laydown to fill the profile.
doctrine: Roll prime — same task family as wall finish (TSK_ROLL_WALL_FINISH 340 SF/hr + TSK_CUTIN_WALL_TO_CEILING). TRADE_MATERIAL fires (eligibility.material:true) → WB_PRIMER 1.25× time multiplier on top of the canonical finish rates.
